# BankTest.pk

> Free online preparation for Pakistani bank recruitment tests in NTS, PTS, OTS and IBP style. Practice quizzes and full tests for SBOTS (State Bank of Pakistan Officers Training Scheme), Meezan Bank PBO, UBL, NBP, HBL, MCB, Allied Bank and Bank of Punjab jobs, with preparation guides for English, mathematics, IQ, current affairs and banking concepts. All questions are original practice material with answers and one-line explanations. No sign-up is needed.

## Practice tests

- [Full Test](https://banktesthelp.github.io/mock.html): a complete timed practice test mixing all subjects
- [All Topics](https://banktesthelp.github.io/topics.html): subject-wise practice quizzes (English, math, IQ, general knowledge, banking, current affairs)
- [State Bank / SBOTS](https://banktesthelp.github.io/sbp.html): SBP and SBOTS 29th Batch practice
- [Meezan Bank](https://banktesthelp.github.io/meezan.html): Meezan Bank PBO practice with Islamic banking questions
- [UBL](https://banktesthelp.github.io/ubl.html): UBL OG-IV, BSO and Relationship Executive practice
- [NBP](https://banktesthelp.github.io/nbp.html): National Bank MTO and OG-II practice
- [HBL](https://banktesthelp.github.io/hbl.html): HBL recruitment test practice
- [MCB](https://banktesthelp.github.io/mcb.html): MCB Bank test practice
- [Allied Bank](https://banktesthelp.github.io/allied.html): Allied Bank test practice
- [Bank of Punjab](https://banktesthelp.github.io/bop.html): BOP test practice
